description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).
The ID of the group that you want to delete.

description.zh: 操作者ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节，后台会记录操作者ID。
description.en: The ID of the user who performs the deletion operation. The ID can be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain only letters and digits.

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~)创建互动消息群组。
- 群组删除后，不再可用，正在群组中的所有人，会被通知群已结束。
- 群组删除后，消息在一段时间之内还是可以查询的，当前为三十天。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
*   Before you call this operation, make sure that you have called the [CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~) operation to create an interactive messaging group.
*   After you delete an interactive messaging group, it is no longer available. Every user in the group is notified that the group is closed.
*   After you delete an interactive messaging group, messages in the group are retained for 30 days.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-message-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --operator-id uid1 --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --OperatorId uid1 --GroupId grouptest
